summary: Phase 149O.5 -- HATP RAE Integration Independent Verification: independently re-verified Phase 149O.4's Wave-6 RAE/HATP production integration against docs/contracts/HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT.md directly, not 149O.4's own summary. Reconstructed the exact one-file production diff via git diff 43a9e2fc^..43a9e2fc (zero UNRELATED hunks; legacy resolve_rollback_approval_evidence/derive_rollback_approval_present confirmed byte-identical by reading the diff directly -- no changed lines in either function). Independently re-derived HATP-REQ-095/096/101-104 from contract sections 29/34. Independently authored a fresh test suite (tests/test_phase_149o_5_hatp_rae_integration_independent_verification.py, 47 passed) importing no fixtures from 149O.4's own suite, exhaustively re-verifying: the 8-row activation-conjunction truth table; the 13-state HATP status matrix (only VALID passes, no default branch, confirmed against a foreign non-enum status object); Decision/Binding identity and digest replay; AG3/AG5 operation binding and cross-family replay in both directions; repository/deployment binding; consumption-time revocation of signer/authority/deployment (discovering, during test authoring, that the trust-store schema requires a revoked_at field alongside status=revoked -- an incomplete mutation still fails closed via a different status, additional unplanned defense-in-depth, Finding F-1); no cached VALID across calls; exception fail-closed behavior for trust-store/provider/readiness-inspection failures; absence of any legacy-flag or caller-forceable bypass parameter; and Threat-A forged-chain reproduction through the gated API specifically (unenrolled signer, fully hand-forged chain, and a fully genuine RAE chain with no HATP proof -- all approval_present=False). Independently confirmed via grep+AST that zero production modules outside rollback_approval_evidence.py itself call either the legacy or the new gated API, and that Permission Broker's approval_present/human_approval_present remain plain caller-supplied CLI booleans with no RAE/HATP import anywhere in the PB module chain (permission_broker.py, permission_broker_foundation.py, mutation_permission.py) -- so B-149O-1..4 are adjudicated REPAIRED AT IMPLEMENTATION LEVEL AND INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AGAINST THE GATED API, with system-level closure explicitly deferred pending Wave-7 AG3/AG5 Permission Broker wiring per HATP-REQ-105/106 (not because any attack succeeds against the new path). Independently verified the real activation gate's mechanism directly from source: two hardcoded False literals feeding an all(...) conjunction force operational=False regardless of the trailing assert statement (noted as OBSERVATION: that specific assert would be stripped under python -O, but has no security consequence since the hardcoded literals alone already force the result). Re-ran all of 149O.4's own regression suites: Wave-4 (136 passed), Wave-5 (2 skipped, environment-limited), Wave-6's own suite (52 passed), RAE full (255 passed / 4 known-open B-149O-1..4-against-legacy-API failures), report-trust (187 passed), and Fast Green (4590 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed) -- all exact matches to 149O.4's recorded baselines. Found one discrepancy (Finding F-3, non-blocking): the Permission-Broker-filtered suite shows 2 failures in this environment, not 149O.4's recorded 1 -- the second, test_rae_permission_broker_agent_still_byte_unchanged_since_freeze, was independently reproduced (via a detached worktree at commit 43a9e2fc) as already failing at 149O.4's own implementation commit, meaning 149O.4's own regression count undercounted by one; a stale byte-freeze boundary test (pinned to pre-Wave-6 commit a278cd93) that Wave 6 legitimately outdated but 149O.4 did not narrow, unlike its two correctly-narrowed Wave-4 boundary tests. Not blocking -- the test correctly detects Wave 6's own legitimate, intended change; narrow follow-up recommended, not performed by this verification-only phase. Zero BLOCKING findings across all named blocking conditions in the governing prompt. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HATP WAVE 6 RAE INTEGRATION CONFORMS. Current deployment approval_present remains mechanically incapable of True. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable, confirmed unchanged before and after. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_5_HATP_RAE_INTEGRATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.6, HATP Class-B Deployment + Activation Implementation (Wave 7).
